up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity records (ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID) for the human single-protein target with CHEMBL ID CHEMBL1075104 and name 'Leucine-rich repeat serine/threonine-protein kinase 2' (organism Homo sapiens, tax_id 9606, target type 'SINGLE PROTEIN'). For each record, return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), taxonomy ID (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard activity type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Only include rows where the standard relation is exactly '=' and the pChEMBL value is not null. Limit the result to 1000 rows, ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending and assay ChEMBL ID ascending.
sql:
SELECT
    ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075104'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
